e.title: SRO（巴西 SUSEP）：三层次保险交易登记系统与数据质量管控
e.title_en: SRO (SUSEP, Brazil): a three-tier insurance transaction registry with built-in data-quality controls
e.title_hk: SRO（巴西 SUSEP）：三層次保險交易登記系統與數據質量管控
e.summary: 巴西保险交易登记系统：保险公司把逐笔交易报给「登记实体」，登记实体校验存储后汇入「集成平台」，集成平台施加数据质量机制再经接口与仪表盘供监管使用，并已衍生出消费者可查自己保单的服务
e.summary_en: Brazil’s insurance transaction registry: insurers send operation-level records to registrar entities, which validate and store them before feeding an integrated platform that applies data-quality mechanisms and exposes data to the regulator through interfaces and dashboards — already yielding services that let consumers see policies in their own name
e.summary_hk: 巴西保險交易登記系統：保險公司把逐筆交易報給「登記實體」，登記實體校驗存儲後匯入「集成平台」，集成平台施加數據質量機制再經接口與儀表盤供監管使用，並已衍生出消費者查閱自身保單的服務
e.body:
**SRO（Sistema de Registro de Operações，交易登记系统）** 是 **SUSEP（巴西保险监管局）** 的**逐笔保险交易数据采集系统**。其目的经官方页面实测写明：**「visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados, aperfeiçoando a Susep em suas atividades de supervisão e prestação de serviços à sociedade e ao Estado」**——**采集被监管市场的「颗粒化（granulares）」交易数据，并把数据开发能力工具化**，以改进 SUSEP 的**监管**职能与**面向社会与国家**的服务。本条目补的是**「监管者的逐笔交易登记架构」这一形态**：实测池内 **operation-level / transaction-level / trade repository / granular data 相关条目为 0**（池内监管数据侧此前是**汇总统计类**——[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 等，**都是「监管者公布汇总数据」，没有「监管者作为逐笔数据登记中心」这一层**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 347.7KB（356,018 字节），标题实测「Sistema de Registro de Operações」**。**三段式架构**实测写明：**「No SRO, o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada」**——**保险市场把交易记录发送给「登记实体（Entidades Registradoras）」，登记实体负责校验、存储并向「集成平台（Plataforma Integrada）」提供数据**；**「A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards」**——**集成平台接收信息、施加「数据质量机制（mecanismos de qualidade de dados）」、并通过接口与仪表盘向 SUSEP 提供**；**「A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade e a outros órgãos de estado」**。**已落地的消费者侧服务**实测写明：**「Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade」**——**「Consulta de Seguros（消费者可访问登记在自己名下的保单）」与「Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia」已是 SRO 的具体成果并对社会开放**。**规划方向**实测写明可能包括**跨金融机构（含保险、补充养老金与资本化产品）的「财务生活」信息聚合**。页面并设有**「Benefícios esperados」**分别面向 **SUSEP / Consumidores / Administração Pública** 说明。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「逐笔数据登记架构」这一形态**——池内监管侧此前**全是「监管者发布汇总统计」**，而 SRO 是**「监管者建一个逐笔登记层，再在登记层之上做监管与公众服务」**；这对做**保险监管数据基础设施**方向的学生，是**比统计门户更上游的一种设计**（可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 并读——**那些是成果，这一条是产生成果的管道**）。**② 「登记实体」这一中间层值得注意**——**监管者不直接收数，而是要求行业通过受认可的登记实体报数，由登记实体承担校验与存储**；这是一种**监管与行业分工的具体制度安排**，与 [[monitora-tiss]] 的「监管者直接监测上报质量」形成**两条治理路线对照**（**一条靠中间机构、一条靠监管者自建程序**）。**③ 「消费者可查自己名下的保单」是保险数据基础设施的直接公共价值**——这一点可与 [[susep-open-insurance]] 的「同意后跨公司共享」连读：**SRO 让客户看到自己的保单，Open Insurance 让客户授权把它共享出去**——**两级设计正好构成一条完整的客户数据主权路径**（可与 [[mpf-fund-platform]] 的香港强积金基金平台、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 的公开登记册对照）。**④ 「granulares（颗粒化）」一词值得单独注意**——**监管数据口径从汇总走向逐笔是国际趋势**，本条目给出了一个**发展中国家的完整实现样本**（含登记实体、集成平台、数据质量机制三个环节）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、三段式架构描述、四段关键正文表述、消费者侧服务名称与规划方向**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**），**但未打开任何 SUSEP 规范性文件、未核实登记实体名单、未打开集成平台或任何接口/仪表盘**，因此**不能转述数据字段、报送频率、校验规则或实际数据量**；**② 「Entidades Registradoras」的制度定义、数量与准入条件本次未核实**——**该词仅作为页面正文术语被引用**；**③ Consulta de Seguros 与 Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia 本次未实际打开使用**，故**不描述其界面、覆盖范围或可用性**；**④ 「规划方向」（跨机构财务生活聚合）实测为页面所述规划，本词条不主张其已实现**；**⑤ 本次未核实 SRO 与 Open Insurance 在技术层面的实际衔接**（**两者的关系描述基于页面各自正文，属合理连读而非官方声明的对接关系**）；**⑥ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**；**⑦ 本次首次探测该 URL 时返回 HTTP 429（速率限制），延迟重试后两次均为 200 且体量一致（356,018 字节）**。**核实说明**：SRO 页（347.7KB/356,018 字节）HTTP 200 实测两次（首次 429 为速率限制，延迟重试后一致）；四段正文逐字读取；**未打开规范性文件、未核实登记实体名单、未使用消费者侧服务**。
e.body_en:
**SRO (Sistema de Registro de Operações)** is **SUSEP’s operation-level insurance transaction data-collection system**. Its stated purpose, read verbatim from the official page, is **"visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados, aperfeiçoando a Susep em suas atividades de supervisão e prestação de serviços à sociedade e ao Estado"** — **to capture granular data on supervised-market operations and to turn the exploitation of that data into capability**, improving SUSEP’s **supervisory** work and its **services to society and the state**. This entry adds the **"regulator as an operation-level registry architect"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for operation-level, transaction-level, trade repository or granular data** (the corpus’s regulatory-data side previously held **aggregate statistics** — [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[ivass]] and others — **all "regulator publishes aggregate data", with no "regulator as an operation-level registry" layer**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 347.7KB (356,018 bytes) with the measured title "Sistema de Registro de Operações"**. The **three-tier architecture** is stated verbatim: **"No SRO, o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada"** — **the insurance market sends operation records to registrar entities (Entidades Registradoras), which validate, store and make the data available to the integrated platform (Plataforma Integrada)**; **"A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards"** — **the integrated platform applies data-quality mechanisms and exposes the data to SUSEP through interfaces and dashboards**; and **"A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade e a outros órgãos de estado"**. **Consumer-facing services already delivered** are stated verbatim: **"Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade"** — **"Consulta de Seguros" (consumers accessing policies registered in their own name) and "Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia" are concrete results already available to society**. **Planned direction** measurably includes **aggregation of "financial life" information across financial institutions, including insurance, supplementary pension and capitalisation products**. The page also carries **"Benefícios esperados"** sections addressing **SUSEP, consumers and public administration** separately.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "operation-level data registry architecture"** — the corpus’s regulatory side previously held **only "regulator publishes aggregate statistics"**, whereas SRO is **"the regulator builds an operation-level registry layer and then layers supervision and public services on top of it"**; for students working on **insurance supervisory data infrastructure**, this is **a design one layer upstream of the statistics portals** (readable with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]] and [[ivass]] — **those are outputs; this is the pipeline producing them**). **② The "registrar entities" middle layer is notable** — **the regulator does not collect data directly but requires the industry to report through accredited registrars that carry out validation and storage**; this is **a concrete institutional division of labour between regulator and industry**, contrasting with [[monitora-tiss]]’s **regulator-run monitoring of reporting quality** (**one route through an intermediary, one through a programme the regulator builds itself**). **③ "Consumers can see policies in their own name" is a direct public value of insurance data infrastructure** — and it reads together with [[susep-open-insurance]]’s "sharing across firms after consent": **SRO lets customers see their policies, Open Insurance lets them authorise sharing them** — **together the two form a complete customer-data-sovereignty path** (comparable with Hong Kong’s [[mpf-fund-platform]] and the public register of [[pensions-authority-ie]]). **④ The word "granulares" deserves separate note** — **a shift in supervisory data from aggregate to operation-level is an international trend**, and this entry gives **a complete implementation sample from a developing economy** (registrar entities, integrated platform and data-quality mechanisms).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, the title, the three-tier architecture description, four verbatim body statements, the consumer service names and the planned direction** (**all read verbatim from the page body**), **but opened no SUSEP normative instrument, verified no list of registrar entities, and opened neither the integrated platform nor any interface or dashboard**, so **data fields, reporting frequency, validation rules and actual data volumes cannot be restated**; **② the institutional definition, number and admission criteria of "Entidades Registradoras" were not verified** — **the term is cited only as it appears in the page text**; **③ Consulta de Seguros and Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia were not actually opened or used**, so **their interface, coverage and availability are not described**; **④ the "planned direction" (cross-institution financial-life aggregation) is measurably presented as a plan, and this entry does not claim it has been implemented**; **⑤ the practical technical linkage between SRO and Open Insurance was not verified** (**the relationship described here rests on each page’s own text and is a reasonable reading rather than an officially stated integration**); **⑥ the page is mainly in Portuguese**; **⑦ the first probe of this URL returned HTTP 429 (rate limiting); after a delay, two retries returned 200 with identical size (356,018 bytes)**. **Verification note**: the SRO page (347.7KB / 356,018 bytes) was measured at HTTP 200 twice (the first 429 was rate limiting; delayed retries were identical); four body statements were read verbatim; **no normative instrument, registrar list or consumer service was opened or used**.
e.body_hk:
**SRO（Sistema de Registro de Operações，交易登記系統）** 是 **SUSEP（巴西保險監管局）** 的**逐筆保險交易數據採集系統**。其目的經官方頁面實測寫明：**「visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados」**——**採集被監管市場的「顆粒化」交易數據並把數據開發能力工具化**。本條目補的是**「監管者的逐筆交易登記架構」這一形態**：實測池內 **operation-level / transaction-level / trade repository / granular data 相關條目為 0**（池內監管數據側此前是**匯總統計類**——[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 等，**都是「監管者公布匯總數據」，沒有「監管者作為逐筆數據登記中心」這一層**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 347.7KB（356,018 位元組），標題實測「Sistema de Registro de Operações」**。**三段式架構**實測寫明：**「o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada」**——**保險市場把交易記錄發送給「登記實體」，由其校驗、存儲並提供給「集成平台」**；**「A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards」**——**集成平台施加「數據質量機制」，並通過接口與儀表盤向 SUSEP 提供**；**「A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade」**。**已落地的消費者側服務**實測寫明：**「Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade」**。**規劃方向**實測含**跨金融機構（含保險、補充養老金與資本化產品）的「財務生活」資訊聚合**。頁面並設 **「Benefícios esperados」** 分別面向 SUSEP／消費者／公共行政說明。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「逐筆數據登記架構」**——池內監管側此前**全是「監管者發布匯總統計」**，而 SRO 是**「監管者建逐筆登記層，再在其上做監管與公眾服務」**；對做**保險監管數據基礎設施**的學生，**這是比統計門戶更上游的設計**（可與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 並讀——**那些是成果，這一條是產生成果的管道**）。**② 「登記實體」這一中間層值得注意**——**監管者不直接收數，而要求行業通過受認可的登記實體報數**；與 [[monitora-tiss]] 的「監管者直接監測上報質量」形成**兩條治理路線對照**。**③ 「消費者可查自己名下的保單」是保險數據基礎設施的直接公共價值**——與 [[susep-open-insurance]] 連讀：**SRO 讓客戶看到自己的保單，Open Insurance 讓客戶授權共享出去**，**兩級構成完整的客戶數據主權路徑**（可與 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 對照）。**④ 「granulares（顆粒化）」一詞值得單獨注意**——**監管數據口徑從匯總走向逐筆是國際趨勢**，本條目給出**一個包含登記實體、集成平台、數據質量機制三個環節的完整樣本**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、三段式架構、四段關鍵正文、消費者側服務名稱與規劃方向**（**均逐字實測**），**但未打開任何 SUSEP 規範性文件、未核實登記實體名單、未打開集成平台或任何接口／儀表盤**，故**不能轉述數據欄位、報送頻率、校驗規則或實際數據量**；**② 「Entidades Registradoras」的制度定義、數量與准入條件未核實**——**該詞僅作為頁面正文術語被引用**；**③ 兩個消費者側服務本次未實際打開使用**，故**不描述其界面、覆蓋範圍或可用性**；**④ 「規劃方向」實測為頁面所述規劃，本詞條不主張其已實現**；**⑤ SRO 與 Open Insurance 的技術層面實際銜接未核實**（**兩者關係描述基於各自頁面正文，屬合理連讀而非官方聲明的對接關係**）；**⑥ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**；**⑦ 首次探測該 URL 時返回 HTTP 429（速率限制），延遲重試後兩次均為 200 且體量一致（356,018 位元組）**。**核實說明**：SRO 頁（347.7KB）HTTP 200 實測兩次；四段正文逐字讀取；**未打開規範性文件、未核實登記實體名單、未使用消費者側服務**。
